Package com.saicone.types

Interface AnnotatedTypeParser<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type result of the function.
All Superinterfaces:
Function<Object,T>, TypeParser<T>
All Known Implementing Classes:
PatternAnnotatedParser
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface AnnotatedTypeParser<T> extends TypeParser<T>
Represents a function that parse any annotated type of object and converts into value type.
